verdict.rationale: Consensus's machine-readable corpus describes its REST API and MCP surface as "stable, versioned JSON endpoints", so the versioning half of the story has a first-party claim. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, or sunset timelines. The developer docs are walled, and the advertised OpenAPI spec link is dead, so the versioning claim cannot be verified. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, any visible version scheme or changelog, a reachable API contract or docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: search, paper detail, synthesis, and the Consensus Meter as stable, versioned JSON endpoints with bearer-token authentication
